query: SELECT Med_disease.disease_type, Med_disease.diagnosis_challenges, Med_drug.prescription_status, Med_drug.unsuitable_population FROM disease JOIN drug ON disease.disease_name = drug.disease_name WHERE Med_drug.activation_conditions != 'no special condition' OR Med_drug.dosage_frequency = 'once or twice a day';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。 源SQL存在未绑定表限定符：Med_disease, Med_drug；图原样保留，字段归属待核，不能直接执行。所需字段：Med_disease.diagnosis_challenges, Med_disease.disease_type, Med_drug.activation_conditions, Med_drug.dosage_frequency, Med_drug.prescription_status, Med_drug.unsuitable_population, disease.disease_name, drug.disease_name

nodes.detail: Med_drug.activation_conditions <> 'no special condition' OR Med_drug.dosage_frequency = 'once or twice a day'
